button.label: Stamp This Folder
button.screentip: Fill the Retention column for up to 6,000 emails in the current folder.

button.label: Stamp Mailbox (6,000)
button.screentip: Fill the Retention column for up to 6,000 emails across this whole mailbox.

button.label: Stamp Mailbox (custom)
button.screentip: Same as above, but you choose how many emails.

button.label: Add Retention Field
button.screentip: Add the Retention field to every mail folder in this mailbox.

button.label: Copy View to All Folders
button.screentip: Copy your current view (with the Retention column) to every mail folder in this mailbox.

button.label: Remove Inline Images
button.screentip: Remove pictures embedded in the selected emails.

button.label: Strip Attachments
button.screentip: Remove (and optionally save) attachments from the selected emails.

button.label: Strip Everything
button.screentip: Remove inline images, then attachments, from the selected emails.
